extraction.notes: EQR does not report an AFFO metric; affo fields null. Its reconciliation starts at Net income and deducts NCI, preferred distributions and preferred redemption premium before FFO available to Common Shares and Units (338,419), which is the ffo_total used. Normalized FFO available to Common Shares and Units (364,896) is the core_total. Two classification judgment calls: 'Premium on redemption of Preferred Shares' was categorized as debt_extinguishment, and 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' (-6,106) was categorized as other because the printed label does not say whether the asset is real estate or non-real-estate. Recurring capex is taken from the Q1 2024 Capital Expenditures to Real Estate total (73,520), which includes renovation spend, so it is an upper bound on maintenance capex. Diluted shares 390,561 reproduce FFO/share 0.87 and Normalized FFO/share 0.93. Verified arithmetic: 305,032 to 302,071 to 338,419 to 364,896.
